description: Return the count and indices of vectors in the dominant cluster. Both centroid and cosine_similarity are module-level helper functions — call them directly, do not define them and do not import any module. If vectors is empty return (0, []). Call centroid(vectors) to get c. Build sims as [cosine_similarity(v, c) for v in vectors]. If threshold == 0.0 set effective = sum(sims) / len(sims), else effective = threshold. Build kept = [i for i, s in enumerate(sims) if s >= effective]. Return (len(kept), kept).
